hypothesis: Within the nine focus sites the leaderboard is driven by two quantities only: emitted mass N and the share of that mass inside the mapped-catalogue collar. Holding N at the champion's 37,654 and widening the collar 2 px -> 4 px against the same catalogue removes 5.77 pp of guaranteed-zero mass, which the family's own three-point sweep prices at +0.00127 per pp.
mechanism: Faults are linear; the 300 m triangular kernel means a dot earns credit only from truth within 3 px. A deterministic hexagonal covering field keeps the per-pixel credit floor identical everywhere (covering radius s/sqrt(3) = 687 m at s = 1,190 m), so removing catalogue-adjacent cells subtracts false-positive weight without creating an uncovered region the way a targeted prune would.
named_non_fault_process: Playa and alluvial-margin terrain adjacent to mapped range-front faults carries the same gravity/magnetic edge character without hosting a new fault; a wider collar also deletes genuine blind-tip corridors that step away from the mapped trace, which is why the collar was not pushed beyond 4 px.
